changes_this_cycle: Expanded non-Mundarica web discovery from 56 to 61 verified source leads without changing the audited MMSC identity total of 27.

Added WEB-MUN-0057 Pallavi Raonka's 2021 Virginia Tech dissertation on Munda politics and land; findings remain fieldwork-period and participant-context bounded and are not generalized to all Munda communities or current practice.
Added WEB-MUN-0058 Carol Marie Babiracki's 1991 University of Illinois ethnomusicology dissertation on the Karam repertory; IDEALS full text is restricted and protected content is not ingested.

Added WEB-MUN-0059 the official Ministry of Tribal Affairs/TRI record DRMTWRI/1993/0007, Munda, researched by Soma Singh Munda; repository metadata is registered without converting source-supplied descriptions into cultural facts.

Added WEB-MUN-0060 Toshiki Osada's 2008 Mundari grammar sketch in The Munda Languages, verified through Glottolog with pages 99-164; Glottolog's metadata licence is explicitly separated from rights in the Routledge chapter.
Added WEB-MUN-0061 ASJP Database Wordlist Mundari as a comparative lexical-dataset lead; ASJP states CC BY 4.0, while underlying-source provenance and cultural-access obligations remain preserved.
Synchronized the MMSC index and reproducible search log to 61 sequential discovery leads while preserving zero discovery leads in the audited identity total.
Extended source-discovery integrity tests through WEB-MUN-0061, including restricted dissertation, TRI/government, chapter-rights and comparative lexical-dataset boundaries.
Regenerated publication JSON and LaTeX release metrics to 61 observed discovery leads and added publication-sync assertions so stale discovery counts now fail tests.

Streamlit needs no filename-specific patch because its discovery loader dynamically loads web_discovery expansion JSON files; the five new leads therefore enter the searchable discovery layer without promotion to cultural evidence.

No cultural, linguistic, religious, political, musical or lexical proposition was promoted from discovery metadata into evidence, and public availability was not interpreted as unrestricted reuse permission.
